sources.title: A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Act 1999
sources.fact: The purchase-credit and separate-cost rules the workflow relies on: GST Act s 75-20 and Division 11. On 22 September 2026, the Register served compilation C2026C00081, compilation 96 dated 1 January 2026. Its volume 1 contains the margin-scheme exclusion in s 75-20 and the creditable-acquisition conditions in ss 11-5, 11-15 and 11-20. These provisions support the existing workflow distinction between the property acquisition and separate costs. No rate, eligibility conclusion or new tax treatment is adopted.
